stage: Own MSAA array compiler/native profile with color CS/VS/FS read/query and color/D32/S8 slice render/resolve/blit

source: MSL constant/constexpr sampler constructors with lexical scope
AIR read-only addrspace(2) i64 or [2 x i64] globals, including constant bitcasts
constant_sampler_profile.allocation: Reserve only used external implicit/gradient i and explicit-LOD i+8 states, then assign literals to the remaining physical slots. Reject any overlap or exhaustion. Implicit and explicit states are separately allocated.
constant_sampler_profile.state: Semantic filters, fixed 8.8 LOD clamps, address modes, anisotropy, border color and coordinates in the immutable program prefix; native A5xx state emitted per dispatch/draw. Public Sampler remains 28 bytes.
unsupported: fractional LOD clamps not representable in 8.8
pixel-coordinate modes outside the current native profile
constant_sampler_profile.internal_glsl_linker: 32 active combined uniforms per VS/FS/CS; virtual binding192 and post-link sampler indices256..511 do not widen public or hardware slots.
constant_sampler_profile.msl_default_address: clamp_to_edge, verified against Apple table2.7; mirror_clamp_to_edge is not an MSL constexpr enum

mrt_profile.msl: Fragment float4 color(n) struct members, sparse slots and independently evaluated outputs
mrt_profile.air: Float4 render_target metadata for up to eight aggregate members with unique indices0..7; dual-source blending index zero only
mrt_profile.native: Immutable compiler output mask and real IR3 register per color; A5xx SP_FS_OUTPUT_REG0..7, highest framebuffer slot plus one in MRT count, per-target address/format/mask/blend state
mrt_profile.lifetime: All color/depth/stencil attachments are checked and retained; physical alias checks cover all attachments, sampled/fetched pixels and stage buffers
mrt_profile.scope: Linear RGBA8/BGRA8 UNorm/sRGB planes, including single-slice/mip views and 2x/4x MSAA attachments; dual-source blending and layered rendering remain unavailable.
mrt_profile.raster_order_groups: Explicitly rejected until fragment interlock is implemented
mrt_profile.aot_jit_interface_assignment: Shared qgpu_assign_graphics_io orders semantic IO locations before IR3; arbitrary AIR aggregate member order does not change compiler entry point behavior.

shader_profile.compute_local_size: runtime variable; uniform groups or exact partial edge groups
shader_profile.texture_type: Color 2D/2DArray/Cube/CubeArray and private 2DMS/2DMSArray; private single-level D32/S8/D32S8 arrays for selected-slice render/resolve/blit
shader_profile.base_vertex: signed int32; every effective non-restart index validated in int64

private_index_snapshot.source: prepared native IOMemoryDescriptor at draw execution

varyings.semantic_identity: SHA-256 first 128 bits over normalized user/field identity; type checked separately
varyings.linking: active FS inputs match semantic identity independently of declaration order

depth_stencil.combined_layout: D32 plane followed by S8; each pitch aligned to 64 bytes; one native buffer
depth_stencil.unaligned_stencil_edge_copy: retire prior GPU work, CPU pack bytes, GPU Fill32 store

vertex_input.formats: Metal formats 1..42 and 45..54; Float/Half, integer, normalized, BGRA8 and RG11B10; RGB9E5 unsupported

shader_profile.compute_buffer_index_proof: NIR byte-range guards; static footprints for legacy programs
shader_profile.shared_bytes_field: former reserved program uint32; widths unchanged
shader_profile.native_texture_alias_check: Per-layer byte unions over pinned physical-page indexes, independent of resource IDs and IOVAs
shader_profile.fragment_discard_stores: Keep earlier resource writes; suppress later stores and supported atomics while helper arithmetic continues; terminate at common exit
shader_profile.fragment_depth_late_test: no_earlyz | discard | replacement depth; actual depth output control and register enabled only for replacement depth
shader_profile.msl_as_type: 32-bit float/int/uint scalar/vector1..4 with matching lane count

jit_profile.registration_privilege: Existing administrator-only native IOGPU connection; trusts compiler shader ISA
jit_profile.runtime_llvm: iOS system libLLVM exported C ABI; symbol availability verified against SDK, actual device parser/CPU compatibility untested
jit_profile.buffer_access: Trusted compiler-owned byte guards and FS bank declaration; administrator-only ISA policy
jit_profile.cube_sampler_metadata: cubeSamplerMask; subset of active samplers, nonzero iff a cube texture is sampled
jit_profile.code_storage: Immutable OSData heap snapshot at registration; code copied into read-only private job IB
jit_profile.constant_sampler_metadata: 600-byte immutable prefix extension; semantic state, exact usage masks and physical slot maps
jit_profile.constant_sampler_admission: Canonical inactive data, supported state, normalized Cube coordinates and unique in-range physical slots
jit_profile.fragment_outputs: 8 float4 colors, optional scalar float depth and scalar uint coverage; void FS allowed
jit_profile.depth_register: Final program scalar is depthReg, inactive zero; independent FRAGMENT_DEPTH flag permits real R0.x
jit_profile.air_float_comparisons: Shared float32 scalar/vector ordered/unordered FCmp expressions, explicit NaN handling
jit_profile.multisample_texture_metadata: multisampleMask plus zero reserved word appended after depthReg
jit_profile.multisample_admission: Immutable resource type mask agrees with 2x/4x native descriptors, no sampler/sample access and no arrays/cubes or MSAA writes
jit_profile.fragment_variants: Required second immutable IR3 code/constant/description payload for every fragment; one public function ID and owner. Nonfragment child is all-zero.

controller_artifact_snapshot_scope: Exact immutable bundles from the current collection;85 GPU/shared-header files were stable across actual native compilation. Other live sources are observations only.

historical_validation.scope: Previous D32/S8 resolve and bitcast milestone with its own versions, evidence and runtime limits. Earlier CPU/boot records remain historical.

source_snapshot_scope: Retained unified toolchain,52 strictly verified compiler/client input paths,85 stable native GPU/shared-header sources and exact immutable native collection verification.
source_hash_scope: Live source bytes at this audit; actual compiler/client receipts and stable native GPU observations identify compiled inputs. Unrelated source observations do not imply those sources were compiled.
artifact_hash_scope: Saved bytes at this audit. Historical reports retain stage context; current_evidence/current_inspection identify the own MSAA-array profile.
remaining_work: Programmable sample positions, memoryless storage and dynamic store-action changes
Post-depth coverage, sample-position/interpolation queries, early_fragment_tests and framebuffer fetch
AIR multisample/array texture intrinsics with verified signatures, depth/stencil shader sampling, argument buffers, wider types/formats and broader language/linking
Layered rendering, dual-source blending and fragment interlock
Persistent task GPU VA, generic IOGPU queues/events and full power/fault behavior
CAMetalLayer/display, system Metal loading and target runtime verification

concurrent_source_observation.scope: Other live-source changes since the previous audit; actual receipts and immutable snapshots determine compiled bytes.

depth_outputs: MSL scalar float struct member depth(any/less/greater)
AIR scalar float air.depth output with depth_qualifier
fragment_profile.nil_fragment_pipeline: private raster_depth_only AOT program for depth/stencil-only pipeline descriptors
fragment_profile.discard: MSL discard_fragment() and AIR air.discard_fragment() with helper-preserving software demotion on A5xx
fragment_profile.lowering: Shared NIR pass remembers discarded lanes, predicates SSBO stores and all supported atomics, then terminates at a common exit; reads/private variables/derivatives continue. GLSL discard-loop escape lowering excludes demote. IR3 false dependencies keep explicit and implicit derivatives before the deferred KILL.
fragment_profile.depth_testing: Late plane mode for no_earlyz, discard or replacement depth; RB_FS_OUTPUT_CNTL.FRAG_WRITES_Z and SP_FS_OUTPUT_CNTL.DEPTH_REGID are enabled only for actual depth exports. LRZ stays disabled.
fragment_profile.wire: Shader31/JIT28; depthReg is an independent scalar output register, inactive zero. The following MSAA extension contains multisampleMask and a zero reserved word. description2424/image41832/Draw2816.
fragment_profile.air_float_comparisons: Both AIR readers share float32 scalar/vector1..4 FCmp lowering for all ordered/unordered predicates, with explicit NaN handling; no optional LLVM fast-math API required.

historical_cpu_mrt_output_semantics.scope: Previous MRT CPU llvmpipe observations of unchanged production GLSL; no CPU graphics execution was added in this milestone. No A540 or Metal execution.

multisample_profile.texture_type: MTLTextureType2DMultisample and MTLTextureType2DMultisampleArray; private linear storage, one mip, rebased single-slice render/resolve views
multisample_profile.native_layout: fdl5 cpp = format bytes * samples; sample array varies fastest in X; pitch alignment grows by the sample count
multisample_profile.render_state: Matching samples across every attachment and PSO; A5xx RB, GRAS and TPL1 raster/destination sample fields; per-target color and depth/stencil pitches
multisample_profile.shader_msl: texture2d_ms<float,read>, read(coord,sample), get_num_samples/get_width/get_height in CS/VS/FS; no samplers
multisample_profile.compute_read: Bounded SSBO sample addressing with sRGB/BGRA/swizzle conversion
multisample_profile.graphics_read: Real IR3 ISAMM using the MSAA texture descriptor and guarded sample/coordinate operands
multisample_profile.color_resolve: Internal resolve_color MSL compute program, linear float4 average, one sRGB encoding; source view swizzle ignored for a framebuffer resolve
multisample_profile.resolve_validation: Same format/extents, single-sample destination; validate all attachment/destination aliases before clears; retain both textures through native fences
multisample_profile.wire: Shader31/JIT28, Texture48/Sampler28/Dispatch824/Draw2816, description2424/image41832; Apple outer resource/queue ABI and native limits264 unchanged
multisample_profile.multisample_mask: Dedicated immutable per-program eight-bit texture mask, separate from render sample count and fragment flags
unsupported: AIR multisample texture intrinsics until their signatures are verified
multisample_profile.primary_reference: build/drivers/gpu-msaa-primary-reference.json; public AIR render sample metadata is reference only, unsupported sample/centroid inputs remain rejected

inputs: MSL uint sample_mask before depth/stencil tests
sample_shading_profile.output: MSL uint sample_mask struct member and AIR scalar uint air.sample_mask; ignored with a single-sample attachment
sample_shading_profile.variants: One public function ID and immutable owner; separate single-sample and MSAA IR3 code/constant/register allocations. Metal PSO and resource validation and native A540 submission select by render sample count.
sample_shading_profile.hardware_mode: A5xx requires live HALF SampleID plus RB_RENDER_CONTROL1.SAMPLEMODE=3. HLSQ pixel/centroid/sample pairs, RB/GRAS enables, center-RHW and coverage export use compiler-owned registers.
sample_shading_profile.position: At sample rate, hoist pixel-center XY and affine Z/reciprocal-W gradient correction before control flow in shared NIR lowering; center-qualified varyings keep pixel interpolators.
sample_shading_profile.air_metadata_reference: steelbrain/metal2vulkan@720ef1ce9ae2a2068999a8675717418b9416283e engine/multisample.air.ll and engine/rt6_resolves.air.ll, recorded in gpu-msaa-primary-reference.json

historical_cpu_msaa_resolve_semantics.scope: CPU llvmpipe execution of the production resolve shader body and image helpers; only the unsupported variable local-size declaration is replaced with local_size1 for this probe. This does not execute A540 ISA, raster state, Metal methods or native queue code.
historical_cpu_msaa_resolve_semantics.launch_adaptation: Remove GL_ARB_compute_variable_group_size requirement and set local_size1; shader body unchanged

depth_stencil_resolve_profile.selection: Strict float32 comparisons select the first matching extremum; depth and stencil use identical selection even when no depth resolve destination is supplied. DepthResolvedSample requires a depth attachment.
depth_stencil_resolve_profile.backend: Bounded native compute SSBO dispatches with immutable AOT IR3; raw uint D32 bit patterns are copied and compared through as_type<float>. No public image retyping or CPU resolve.
depth_stencil_resolve_profile.stencil_packing: One work item owns a complete destination uint word; 1..3 trailing padding bytes are preserved and no inter-thread byte RMW occurs.
depth_stencil_resolve_profile.validation: Same plane format/extent; 2x/4x source and 1x destination; check all attachment and resolve aliases before clears. Combined D32S8 planes may share non-overlapping backing.
depth_stencil_resolve_profile.lifetime: Keep source, destination, depth dependency and parameter buffer alive through ordinary native queue/fence completion.
depth_stencil_resolve_profile.wire: Existing Shader31/JIT28, description2424/image41832, Dispatch824 and native resource/queue ABI unchanged.

msl_bitcasts_profile.scope: as_type<T> for float/int/uint 32-bit scalar/vector1..4 with matching lane count; GLSL overload checking rejects mismatched shapes or other scalar widths.
msl_bitcasts_profile.lowering: uintBitsToFloat/intBitsToFloat, floatBitsToUint/floatBitsToInt and bit-preserving int/uint conversion; identity casts preserve their source.
unsupported: casts involving padded float3 and a different lane count

multisample_array_profile.allocation: Private, single mip; page-aligned layer stride; total extent constrained by native resource limits.
multisample_array_profile.compute_backend: Guarded SSBOs using native image and per-layer stride constants.
multisample_array_profile.graphics_backend: Real A540 IR3 ISAMM with array flag, sampler2DMSArray lowering and native MSAA/array descriptors; no sampler required.
multisample_array_profile.depth_stencil: D32/S8/D32S8 arrays are render/resolve/blit-only and private. Combined arrays keep separate page-aligned depth/stencil layer strides.
multisample_array_profile.views: Array ranges and same-sample 2D/2DMS single-slice views preserve original per-plane strides and backing.
multisample_array_profile.render_resolve: Select source and destination slices, then existing color/D32/S8 GPU resolve kernels. Whole arrays and layered rendering remain rejected.
multisample_array_profile.alias_checks: Include both D32S8 planes and sort actual intervals before recording multi-slice copies.
multisample_array_profile.platform_scope: Own compiler/native profile: iOS18 SDK exposes texture type8 from iOS14; Apple MSL specification lists multisample arrays for macOS and does not list standard iOS language support. No Apple family conformance inferred.
unsupported: AIR multisample-array intrinsics without verified signatures

historical_cpu_depth_stencil_resolve_sem.scope: CPU execution of actual production GLSL bodies; only local-size declaration adapted. No A540 ISA, Metal methods or native queue executed.

cpu_msaa_array_semantics.scope: CPU execution of original generated GLSL bodies with local-size declaration adapted only; no A540, descriptors, Metal or native queue execution.
